decisions: Option A accepted (Gradle routing in project-router): settings.gradle/settings.gradle.kts = multi-project root (analogous to the Maven reactor); build.gradle/build.gradle.kts = project (analogous to the nearest pom.xml). Precedence in a mixed tree, outermost-first: settings.gradle root > Maven reactor pom > nearest build.gradle > nearest pom. Adds INV-ROUTE-4 to harness/docs/design/runtime-model.md as additive (INV-ROUTE-1/-2/-3 stay Maven-specific for their done oracles).

Option B (build.gradle only, ignore settings.gradle) rejected: mis-routes multi-project Gradle builds — each subproject (e.g. aeron-client, aeron-archive) would become a separate workspace, losing cross-module resolution that buildship needs the settings.gradle root for.
Prior decisions (Option A didOpen/wait + INV-DIAG-4 reword; Option R project-router Maven reactor-root) remain in force and are recorded above / in DECISIONS.md.
acceptedRisks: Gradle root detection is validated against the settings.gradle/build.gradle marker layout (including the real aeron repo), not against a Gradle-model parser — an atypical layout (e.g. settings.gradle.kts with non-standard include) could be misclassified, same class of risk as the Maven <modules> detection.
The mixed Maven+Gradle tree precedence is specified by rule, not exercised by a real mixed-build fixture — rare in practice, documented as an accepted risk.
